purpose: Verify that MachineSignal's local MCP tool manifest, .well-known manifest, OpenAPI contract and local adapter speak the same machine-readable language before any hosted MCP or public registry work.

schema_parity_requirements.requirement: Root manifest and .well-known manifest must expose the same tool names and same input schemas for core API tools.
Every manifest tool that points to the MachineSignal API worker must map to an OpenAPI method and path.
Manifest auth none/customer_api_key/admin_api_key must match OpenAPI public or ApiKeyAuth requirements.
Manifest requires_idempotency_key must match OpenAPI required Idempotency-Key headers for score, purchase and payment-test writes.
All OpenAPI required inputs must be required or safely represented in the manifest tool schema.
Every manifest API tool input property must be documented in OpenAPI as body, path or query input.
Target Discovery fields market, area and commercial_objective must be present in OpenAPI PurchaseIntentRequest and manifest create_purchase_intent.
create_sandbox_customer must use evaluator_type, integration_target and expected_test_path consistently across manifest and OpenAPI.

json_rpc_errors.name: adapter_startup_failed
json_rpc_errors.meaning: Adapter could not load manifest or start.

adapter_tool_errors.name: unknown_tool
adapter_tool_errors.meaning: Requested tool is not present in manifest.

adapter_tool_errors.name: missing_customer_api_key
adapter_tool_errors.meaning: Customer-protected tool called before create_sandbox_customer or without customer key.

adapter_tool_errors.name: missing_admin_api_key
adapter_tool_errors.meaning: Admin tool called without admin key.

adapter_tool_errors.name: missing_idempotency_key
adapter_tool_errors.meaning: Write tool requiring Idempotency-Key was called without idempotency_key argument.

adapter_tool_errors.name: url_error
adapter_tool_errors.meaning: Remote resource could not be reached by adapter.

known_non_blocking_contract_strictness.reason: A machine-facing payment-test call is clearer when amount_eur is supplied, while the API can still derive or tolerate missing amount in sandbox mode.

pass_criteria: all API tools in manifest map to OpenAPI operations
auth, idempotency, path parameters and required inputs align
target discovery machine fields are documented in OpenAPI and manifest
sandbox customer fields align between manifest and OpenAPI
local adapter negative errors are structured
no obvious secrets are written to reports
